name: run-in-project-ancestors-and-csv-rebase
body: The project-bound spawn sets APG_CALLER_ANCESTORS only when ToolContext.ancestors carries a session-id chain, and the opencode 2.x executor context supplies none, so the variable is omitted and the binary treats an absent chain like an empty one; the spawn also rebases only the CSV columns named in opts.rebaseColumns against the resolved worktree, so a non-CSV rendered identity passes through verbatim. Upgrade when the plugin context exposes the session parentID chain, or when a project-bound tool needs a non-CSV identity rebase.
